text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A provincial minister in northern Zambia said the Democratic Republic of Congo will use public firing squads against adulterers and has banned businesswomen from travelling to the country unaccompanied in a bid to reduce prostitution.
- Namibia denied reports that it imposed a ban on Zambian maize exports due to the presence of the Larger Grain Borer in parts of Zambia.
- Former president Kenneth Kaunda challenged police to arrest and charge him for recruiting mercenaries to destablise the country as claimed by the government.
- Zimbabwean authorities at the Victoria Falls border post arrested 20 Zambians over illegal currency transactions.
- Government officials met the heads of 12 political parties to lay the ground for inter-party talks over unresolved electoral issues.
